text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon has captivated the entire venue
with her magnificent running!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A respectable finish for Hishi Amazon!
Nonetheless, it was a run that builds great expectations for the future!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Brian...
It seems she still hasn't fully regained her form since returning from her break...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sight of a genius who had lost her former prowess sent massive shockwaves through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Has it not fully healed yet?
Will I... really be able to make a comeback like this?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I wonder if we'll ever get to see that Narita Brian from back then again...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
choice_data_list: Narita Brian still isn't at her best, huh.
Narita Brian still isn't at her best, is she.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's gradually coming back to me.
Running together made me realize it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels like something is missing.
What on earth could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainy!
Let's head back and do full-power uphill dashes!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She ought to be completely exhausted right after a GⅠ race.
Just to be sure, I asked her why—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've got a pretty good idea of what I need to do now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"To do that,
I need to get to as high a place as possible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the full details, but...
Either way, it seems necessary if I'm to challenge Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though the world around them changes, Hishi Amazon and Narita Brian remain entirely unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day on, the days of intense training continued.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Today, having achieved victory in numerous GⅠ races, her powerful running has become the talk of the town—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
We'll now be conducting a pre-race interview
with Hishi Amazon-san for the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, good to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
In last year's Arima Kinen, you called
Narita Brian your rival, but—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Is there anyone in the Japan Cup you would consider a rival?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My rival hasn't changed.
The wall I have to overcome is Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone knew Narita Brian was in a slump.
Curiously, they all listened intently to what Hishi Amazon had to say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "I know about the slump. I know people are disappointed, and I understand the anxiety her fans are feeling, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's true Brian isn't running monstrous
races like before! But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's not done yet.
You guys know that deep down too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian" isn't strong
just because she's talented.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She's strong because she can't help but run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's straightforward words
echoed through the quiet press conference room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to feel anxious at all.
You'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She is "Narita Brian."
She'll claw her way back up for sure.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...
My rival hasn't changed one bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon's attitude quickly spread throughout the world—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...Did you see Hishi Amazon's interview?
She said Narita Brian is her rival.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I saw it. I dunno...
Seeing that kinda struck a chord with me, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you mention it, Narita Brian's expression
while running hadn't changed from before at all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words like that began to be heard
here and there.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's do this, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As strong and gallant as ever,
Hishi Amazon's back fades into the distance as she dashes up the hill course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Only a little longer until the Japan Cup.
